text:
An electric kettle has a metal casing. The cable for the kettle contains a wire that is connected to
the earth pin of the plug.
Which danger does this guard against?
A
the cable to the kettle becoming too hot
B
the casing of the kettle becoming live
C
the casing of the kettle becoming wet on the outside
D
the casing of the kettle overheating

options.label: A
options.text: the cable to the kettle becoming too hot

options.label: B
options.text: the casing of the kettle becoming live

options.label: C
options.text: the casing of the kettle becoming wet on the outside

options.label: D
options.text: the casing of the kettle overheating
